## Primary source

Link to the paper, official repository, dataset record, or benchmark specification.

## Proposed canonical section

Choose one section from the README.

## Neutral description

Aim for 20–40 words. Describe the engineering task, the evaluation setting, and the material limitation.

## Evidence tags

For example: `[2026] [hardware] [public-data] [open-code] [latency-reported]`

Use only applicable tags; use `[preprint]` only when the source has not passed peer review; omit unknown code, data, or latency status.

## Why it belongs

Which explicit engineering metric, reusable artifact, or system result makes this independently recommendable?
